sentences.scenario: Tell a new colleague your job title.
sentences.source_note: Correct job title used successfully; contrasts with repeated confusion between 是 and 做.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shì zuò ruǎnjiàn gōngchéng de.
sentences.scenario: Explain what kind of work you do.
sentences.source_note: Repeatedly omitted the final 的 when describing software engineering work.

sentences.scenario: Say which company you work for.
sentences.source_note: Successful personal answer reinforces the workplace-before-verb correction.

sentences.chinese: 我在苹果公司工作四年了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài Píngguǒ gōngsī gōngzuò sì nián le.
sentences.english_hint: I've worked at Apple for four years.
sentences.scenario: Answer how long you've worked at Apple.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated 四年工作 word order; four years was stated in the lesson.

sentences.chinese: 我在美国住了十二年了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài Měiguó zhù le shí'èr nián le.
sentences.english_hint: I've lived in the US for twelve years.
sentences.scenario: Explain how long you've lived in the US.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects the learner's residence-duration sentence and preserves twelve years.

sentences.chinese: 我的阅读能力比口语好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de yuèdú nénglì bǐ kǒuyǔ hǎo.
sentences.english_hint: My reading is better than my speaking.
sentences.scenario: Explain your strengths when studying Chinese.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this comparison drill for the learner's stronger reading and recurring comparison difficulty.

sentences.chinese: 现在我说英语比说俄语多得多。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ shuō Yīngyǔ bǐ shuō Éyǔ duō de duō.
sentences.english_hint: Now I speak English much more often than Russian.
sentences.scenario: Describe which language you use more often.
sentences.source_note: Preserves the learner's explicit clarification about frequency rather than language ability.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ Yīngyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 英文说很好 by supplying the subject and 得 complement.

sentences.chinese: 我给你介绍一个新同事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ jièshào yí ge xīn tóngshì.
sentences.english_hint: Let me introduce a new colleague to you.
sentences.scenario: Introduce a new colleague at work.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated use of 跟 instead of 给 in introductions.

sentences.chinese: 我把其他同事介绍给你。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ qítā tóngshì jièshào gěi nǐ.
sentences.english_hint: I'll introduce the other colleagues to you.
sentences.scenario: Help someone meet the rest of the team.
sentences.source_note: Corrects mixed 跟给 wording; the learner later produced this complete pattern successfully.

sentences.english_hint: I recognize five hundred Chinese characters.
sentences.scenario: Describe how many Chinese characters you recognize.
sentences.source_note: Analysis distinguishes character recognition from reading ability; learner self-corrected 五百个汉字.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jù huà wǒ kàn de dǒng.
sentences.english_hint: I can understand this written sentence.
sentences.scenario: Confirm that you understand a sentence on the screen.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this pattern to separate written understanding from knowing how to read characters aloud.

sentences.chinese: 这段录音我大概能听懂百分之六十。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn lùyīn wǒ dàgài néng tīngdǒng bǎifēnzhī liùshí.
sentences.english_hint: I can understand about sixty percent of this recording.
sentences.scenario: Report how much of the lesson recording you understood.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill preserves the reported listening estimate; 六十 became 十六 twice.

sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ xué le hěn duō Zhōngwén.
sentences.english_hint: I've learned a lot of Chinese recently.
sentences.scenario: Tell your teacher about your recent progress.
sentences.source_note: Corrected recent-learning sentence was later retrieved successfully during review.
